why: A HIGH severity bug: firstName returns the second word instead of the first, so welcomeBack displays wrong names.

findings.title: firstName returns the second word instead of the first
findings.body: The function promises to return "the person's first name" but uses array index `[1]` which accesses the second element. For "Ada Lovelace", it returns "Lovelace" instead of "Ada". Fix: change `split(" ")[1]` to `split(" ")[0]`.

pre_merge.detail: Test uses loose regex /^Welcome back, / that would pass with wrong name

walkthrough: Adds firstName(name) function that should return the first word of a name
Adds welcomeBack(name) function that uses firstName for informal greetings
Adds test for welcomeBack using a loose regex that doesn't verify the correct name
